# BerryShot

BerryShot is a lightweight screenshot and screen capture app for macOS, featuring drawing annotations, local OCR text extraction, and ChatGPT/Claude AI integration.

## Documentation and Navigation
- [BerryShot Landing Page](/index.html): The main page showcasing features and interactive demo.
- [BerryShot Documentation](/docs.html): Detailed documentation and user guide for BerryShot.

## Features
- **Local Vision OCR**: 100% offline, privacy-focused text extraction using Apple's Vision framework.
- **AI Assistant**: Interactive AI chat with multi-prompt queueing, stop generation, language awareness, and deep understanding of the app's features to guide you.
- **Screen Recording**: HEVC 60fps recording with system audio, microphone support, and pause/resume capabilities.
- **Scrolling Capture**: Stitch multiple screenshots together for long webpages or documents.
- **Rich Annotations**: Pixel-perfect drawing, shapes, arrows, lines, text, and highlights.
- **Screenshot History**: Automatic local history with SwiftData for browsing and managing past captures.
- **Native SwiftUI App**: Fast, lightweight, and seamlessly integrated into the macOS menubar.
